rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice before an adjective or stative verb.

example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 hou2 fu2

rows.note: Use this colloquial intensifier when the degree is striking or impressive.

example.english: You got an extremely high score this time.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ging6 gou1 fan1 wo3

rows.note: Use this casual, emphatic choice for a youthful ‘super-’ tone.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ciu1 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Choose this for a stronger and somewhat more formal or deliberate statement than 好.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3
